posts.community: Highness Microelectronics Ltd: a SMILE-type opportunity in electronics manufacturing?
posts.text: Highness is exhibiting at SEMICON India. From their LinkedIn page: We’re exhibiting at SEMICON India 2026, 17–19 September, New Delhi. This year, we’re not bringing a product catalogue. We’re bringing the manufacturing depth behind it: three new capabilities: our glass cutting line, and Chip on Glass and Film on Glass bonding, all in-house for the first time. If you’re in display manufacturing, systems integration, or procurement for railways, medical, defence, or industrial infrastructure, this is worth stopping by for. Proud to be part of an event bringing together India’s semiconductor ecos…
